StackJson.description:
A deployment topology node.

Inputs: targets, components, explicit graph nodes, and environment overlays.
Outputs: one normalized stack graph.

components.description: Typed component instances that lower into the stack graph.

StackComponentJson.description:
A typed graph expansion.

Inputs: component type, optional version, and typed `with` parameters.
Outputs: named graph nodes in the lowered stack.

type.description:
Open component type identifier.

Builtin archetypes currently blessed by Destack are:
`destack.sh/component/client`,
`destack.sh/component/service`,
`destack.sh/component/worker`,
and `destack.sh/component/job`.

Typed component inputs.

For builtin archetypes this object should match the corresponding
client, service, worker, or job parameter shape.
Runtime and platform remain target-scoped rather than component-scoped.

domain.description: Optional public domain for the lowered client service.

match.description: Optional route match for the lowered ingress rule.

serviceEnv.description: Optional public environment binding name for the bound service url.

assets.description: Static asset directory or asset binding.

mount.description: Optional workload mount or handler path.

match.description: Optional route match for the lowered ingress rule.

service.description: Upstream service that activates this workload.

An executable compute node.

Inputs: one target, bindings, mounts, env transport, and runtime policy.

target.description: Artifact target consumed by this workload.

run.description: How this workload is run or triggered.

mount.description: Optional mount path or handler path.

oneOf.description: Run as a one-shot background job.

binding.description: Binding name to expose as an environment variable.

regions.description: Regions where this workload may run.

oneOf.description: Shift traffic between blue and green pools.

minAvailable.description: Minimum available instances during voluntary disruption.

StackServiceJson.description:
A stable bindable capability or endpoint.

Inputs: either named workloads or one external url, plus protocol, placement, and service config.
Outputs: addressable fields such as `url` for bindings and ingress.

Workloads behind this service.

Exactly one of `workloads` or `url` should be set.

url.description:
External endpoint for unmanaged services.

Exactly one of `workloads` or `url` should be set.

A passive mountable storage node.

Inputs: size, class, and provider config.
Outputs: mount handles for workloads.

StackConfigJson.description:
A passive configuration node.

Inputs: inline data or one file source.

An external routing surface.

Inputs: callbacks, trusted origins, TLS defaults, and egress rules.
Outputs: connectivity constraints for platform lowering.

StackEnvironmentJson.description:
A partial environment overlay over one named stack.

Inputs: explicit overrides for graph nodes and policy.
